name: io.github.bailinghub/bailinghub-governance
title: BailingHub for Business Operations
description: Let AI agents query and operate business systems with authorization, approval and audit trails.

environmentVariables.name: BAILINGHUB_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Absolute URL of the self-hosted BailingHub deployment.

environmentVariables.name: BAILINGHUB_CLIENT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Dedicated BailingHub Client Token restricted to the configured route.

environmentVariables.name: BAILINGHUB_ROUTE
environmentVariables.description: One allowlisted BailingHub route fixed by the operator for this server process.

environmentVariables.name: BAILINGHUB_ALLOW_INSECURE_HTTP
environmentVariables.description: Optional explicit override for operator-controlled private HTTP networks.
